name: academia_industry_portal
description: Skillhouse — Academia-Industry Collaboration Portal. Frontend is pure HTML5 + CSS3 + vanilla JavaScript (ES6+) — no build step, no frontend framework. Backend (backend/) is a dependency-free Node.js API using only built-in modules (http, node:sqlite, crypto) — no Express/axios/cors/dotenv are used anywhere in this project. Run `npm run dev` to start both the backend API and a frontend static server together in one command (recommended, especially after a Windows restart); or run `npm start` for the backend only and serve the frontend separately (e.g. VS Code Live Server).
